Author: Yesanith
Name: Regions of XIV
Punchline: A beautiful area notification as you walk in and out of zones.
Description:
Announces the region, zone, area and sub-area you walk into with a styled, animated on-screen notification. It can announce weather changes too, and redraw the game's own banners — Quest Accepted, Duty Commenced, Level Up! — in the same style.

Every line takes its own colours, outline, drop shadow and font — one of the game's own faces, or any font file on your PC.

Inspired by Nekres' "Regions of Tyria" for Guild Wars 2.

Open settings with /regions.
